test_quiver2x2: test the Dynamics2x2Axes quiver method to visualize 2x2 game dynamics as a directional field plot
test_streamplot2x2: test the Dynamics2x2Axes streamplot method to visualize 2x2 game dynamics as a streamline plot
test_quiver3x3: test the Dynamics3x3Axes quiver method to visualize 3x3 symmetric game dynamics as a directional field plot
test_streamplot3x3: test the Dynamics3x3Axes streamplot method to visualize 3x3 game dynamics as a simplex streamline plot
test_meshgrid: test the _eval_dynamics_2x2_grid function to evaluate population dynamics on a 2D mesh-grid for 2x2 games
